tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · 2026 Forms W-2 and W-3
tasks.description: Prepare the 2026 Forms W-2 and W-3 for HANGS General Contracting from 7 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Build every employee’s boxes from the year’s payroll: wages, Social Security up to the 2026 wage base, Medicare, and box 12 codes D for 401(k) deferrals and TT for qualified overtime. Value the company pickups’ personal use, and tie the W-3 to the four Forms 941 and the payroll ledger. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft W-2 and W-3 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
